Evidence / output: Discover: interview two or three users and map the current approval process.
Scope: choose one journey and define record ownership, role permissions and acceptance criteria.
Prepare: sketch three screens, create synthetic data, approve accounts and define server-side validation.
Build: create Lovable prototype and backend; connect GitHub; use Claude Code for bounded reviewed changes if qualified.
Evaluate: test the main flow, invalid inputs, access isolation, approval transitions and service errors in staging.
Release: resolve critical findings, rehearse rollback and backup restoration, obtain owner approval and deploy to a named small group.
Operate: monitor privacy-conscious errors, usage and costs for seven days; address one feedback cycle.
Hand over: transfer repository/service ownership safely, document run instructions, recovery and update responsibilities.
